title: Guest checkout with a Virtual Card Token and a DTVC
summary: For web guest checkouts with a simple card form, Mastercard points integrators to Mastercard Virtual Card Tokens. After user validation and consent the integrator gets a token number, expiry and a one-time DTVC, which the agent types into the form. Mastercard validates the DTVC at authorization.

steps.label: User validation and consent
steps.detail: The user is validated and consents before a security code is requested.

steps.label: Request checkout for merchant domain
steps.detail: The integrator, here the agent platform, asks Mastercard for a checkout for a given merchant web domain.

steps.label: Return token, expiry and DTVC
steps.detail: Mastercard returns the virtual card token, its expiry date and a newly generated one-time DTVC. Mastercard pages expand DTVC both as Dynamic Token Validation Code and as Dynamic Token Verification Code.

steps.label: Type values into card form
steps.detail: The agent fills the card number, expiry and security code fields. The merchant sees an ordinary card form submission.

steps.label: Submit authorization
steps.detail: The merchant processes the payment through its usual acquirer.

steps.label: Authorization with token
steps.detail: Mastercard processes the token and validates the DTVC.

failures.outcome: Validation fails and the issuer is told (outcome and response code not published)

steps.label: Tell issuer DTVC result
steps.detail: The authorization request tells the issuer whether DTVC validation was performed; the issuer approves or declines.
